avgRating.description: Average catalogue rating on a 0-5 scale multiplied by 10, matching getExplore.

main.description: Browse the web author directory: up to 500 first authors ranked by summed ratings, with at least two books and positive total ratings. Search filters this bounded directory, not the entire catalogue. Does not require authentication.

language.description: Restrict directory statistics to a supported catalogue language, matching the web directory. Unsupported languages fall back to all languages.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of author name, trimmed and applied before pagination.

offset.description: Next offset into the filtered directory.

total.description: Number matching q within the bounded directory, not a whole-catalogue author count.

directoryLimit.description: Maximum directory size before the optional name filter (500).
